title: Geometry - Lesson 9 Practice: Geometric Constructions
description: Practice construction vocabulary, tool choices, triangle centers, and basic congruence justifications.

questions.question: Which tool is best for copying a segment length without reading a numerical measurement?
questions.explanation: A compass transfers a distance directly, which is why it is central to segment constructions.

questions.question: A triangle is constructed by drawing a base and then using two compass arcs from the base endpoints to locate the third vertex. Which congruence idea usually justifies the triangle?
questions.explanation: The base gives one side, and the two arcs set the other two side lengths, so SSS justifies the constructed triangle.

questions.question: Which triangle center is found by constructing perpendicular bisectors of the sides?
questions.explanation: The circumcenter is the intersection of the perpendicular bisectors and is equidistant from the triangle vertices.

questions.question: An altitude from a triangle vertex must be perpendicular to the line containing the opposite side.
questions.explanation: An altitude is defined by perpendicularity; in obtuse triangles it may meet an extension of the opposite side.

questions.question: The compass width may be changed while copying a segment, as long as the drawing looks about the same length.
questions.explanation: Changing the compass width breaks the equal-distance reason that proves the copied segment is congruent.

questions.question: A segment from a triangle vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A median connects a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.

questions.question: The intersection of the angle bisectors of a triangle is the ______.
questions.explanation: The incenter is formed by angle bisectors and is equidistant from the sides of the triangle.

questions.question: Explain why construction arcs are useful evidence in a geometric construction.
questions.correctAnswer: Construction arcs show that the same compass radius or copied distance was used, which supports claims about congruent segments, congruent angles, and the final constructed relationship.
questions.explanation: Visible arcs help connect the drawing to the geometric reason behind it.
